name: Ghost
description: Ghost is a free and open-source blogging platform written in JavaScript and distributed under the MIT License, designed to simplify the process of online publishing for individual bloggers as well as online publications. This version includes mapping for MariaDB and SMTP. Big credits to Bitnami for the amazing image. Another fine product, brought to you by IBRACORP.

variables.name: GHOST_HOST
variables.description: If you want to access your application from a public IP or hostname you need to set this environment variable to your public IP or hostname. E.g. blog.example.com

variables.name: BLOG_TITLE
variables.description: Ghost blog title. Default: User's Blog

variables.name: MARIADB_HOST
variables.description: Hostname for MariaDB server. Default: mariadb

variables.name: MARIADB_PORT_NUMBER
variables.description: Port used by MariaDB server. Default: 3306

variables.name: GHOST_DATABASE_NAME
variables.description: Database name that Ghost will use to connect with the database. Default: bitnami_ghost

variables.name: GHOST_DATABASE_USER
variables.description: Database user that Ghost will use to connect with the database. Default: bn_ghost

variables.name: GHOST_DATABASE_PASSWORD
variables.description: Database password that Ghost will use to connect with the database. No defaults.

variables.name: ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD
variables.description: It can be used to allow blank passwords. Default: no

variables.name: SMTP_SERVICE
variables.description: SMTP service to use. E.g. GMail or Mailgun

variables.name: SMTP_SECURE_CONNECTION
variables.description: Use a secure connection for SMTP. true or false

variables.name: GHOST_PROTOCOL
variables.description: Protocol to use in the application URLs. Valid values are https or https. Default: http

variables.name: GHOST_PASSWORD
variables.description: Ghost application password. The minimum length is 10 characters. Default: bitnami123
